strengths.item: The paper is organized in a logical sequence: motivation, method formulation, generalization discussion, Euclidean experiments, graph-domain experiments, and appendices.
The ICLR-style layout is generally clean and easy to scan, with readable body text, consistent section hierarchy, and well-formatted numbered equations.
Key figures and tables usually have informative captions, especially the architecture schematic and dataset/result summaries.
The main idea—combining a Runge-Kutta recurrent structure with a shared GNN module—is understandable at a high level.

weaknesses.item: Several central notational choices are compressed or ambiguous, including the PDE notation in Eq. 1, the dependence of the governing function on spatial derivatives/graph structure/boundary conditions, and the use of set notation in the RK equations.
Some terminology is inconsistent or potentially confusing, such as referring to “constant coefficients” while later treating coefficients as varying node, edge, or global features.
Several visual elements are too small for easy inspection, including multi-panel heatmaps and plots in Figures 3–5; axis labels, colorbars, legends, and subplot annotations can be difficult to read.
Repeated cyan/blue text in the abstract/introduction and around Table 1 is visually distracting and looks like a possible formatting or editing artifact unless intentionally used for hyperlinks.
Some experimental details are deferred to appendices, requiring cross-referencing to verify what varies across datasets and what inputs the model receives.

dimension_review.evidence_summary: The PDF inspection found that pages 1–2 have clean layout but distracting cyan/blue full-sentence text; Figure 1 on page 3 and Figure 2 on page 4 are generally legible and well captioned; Figure 3 on page 6 and Figures 4–5 on pages 7–8 contain small labels, colorbars, legends, and dense subplots; Table 1 is mostly legible but visually crowded. Text inspection found a sensible section organization, but noted ambiguity in Eq. 1, the RK set notation, coefficient terminology, and compressed explanations of how graph features, coefficients, time step, and RK stages are used.
dimension_review.rationale: The presentation is good overall: the paper is readable, visually structured, and the main method and experimental flow can be followed. However, notable notation ambiguity, dense explanations, small multi-panel figures, and distracting formatting artifacts make some claims and results harder to verify quickly. These issues are significant but do not make the paper broadly hard to understand, so a score of 3 is appropriate.
